title: Enhanced Glow
description: Minecraft's Items, Blocks, and Mobs with a Vibrant Glowing Take!
body:
![Enhanced Glow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/00f149f0af12f1b3786663f3e0e08a94d6f3661a.png)

##                                      **About:** 

Enhanced Glow is a texture pack for recent versions that aims to take the Minecraft experience in a more vibrant and magical route. The textures for items, blocks, and mobs are now more detailed, emissive, and eye-catching in the dark. This is the perfect texture pack for those who want their Minecraft to feel more alive during deep cave explorations and dangerous nights with glowing monsters to face.

#                                        **Attention:**

This pack was made to be utilized with emissive texture features. You must use [Optifine](https://optifine.net/downloads) or equivalent alternative mods (like [Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity) or[Entity Texture Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures)) to experience the glowing effects. Without them, the game will look completely normal.

For the absolute best visual experience, running this pack alongside Shaders (like Complementary or BSL) is highly recommended to achieve a beautiful bloom effect.
